statement: Private-alpha readiness does not authorize public production deployment.
product_boundary: Local-only, single-host private alpha. Backend on 127.0.0.1:8765, frontend on localhost:3000. No public URL, no tunnel, no DNS record.
Invite only. Public self-registration is not enabled and cannot be enabled by automation.
No broker, exchange or paid-provider connection exists. The capability is absent, not merely disabled.
No trading, broker or provider credential is requested, accepted or stored.
No account, balance or position is accessed. No order is submitted, modified or cancelled.
No paper or live execution. Live trading remains prohibited.
Missions execute local deterministic tools and mock providers only.
No cloud backup, cloud monitoring, external telemetry, or email/SMS/push alerting.
No uptime guarantee and no service-level agreement.
Certified on macOS arm64 only, Python 3.11/3.12, Node >= 18.

certification_limitations.limitation: The M340 accessibility result is a structural audit of the three surfaces this milestone changed — keyboard reachability, focus order, labels, heading semantics, live-region announcements, table semantics and scroll containment. It is not a WCAG conformance claim.
not_covered: automated axe or WCAG rule scan
surfaces outside the three changed files
certification_limitations.why: The repository has no axe or jest-axe harness and adding one was outside this milestone's scope.

certification_limitations.limitation: The soak is bounded by what the 8 GB Apple Silicon reference machine can sustain, not by a production traffic model. It reports the duration it actually sustained and never claims one it did not.
not_covered: adversarial or fuzzed input at volume

certification_limitations.limitation: Mission, approval, execution, cancellation and revocation are driven through the local platform API and then verified in the rendered UI, because the private-alpha UI has no separate mutation surface for them.
not_covered: routes outside the five certified private-alpha routes
cookie and browser-storage inspection, which browser-control safety rules prohibit
certification_limitations.attributed_separately: The pre-existing SaathiOS app shell polls /api/v1/connectors/*, which answers 401 without CORS headers on this local harness. Those 5 request failures and 10 console messages predate this milestone and are reported under preexisting_shell_request_failures and preexisting_shell_console_errors rather than discarded.

certification_limitations.limitation: Next.js inlines NEXT_PUBLIC_* at build time, so the certification harness rebuilds the frontend against the certification API port (127.0.0.1:8343). The default production build recorded in M343_PRODUCTION_BUILD_LOG.txt is a separate, unmodified build.
certification_limitations.why: Recorded explicitly so the two build artifacts are not confused.

certification_limitations.limitation: The certification asserts the absence of registration, broker-connectivity, credential, account-access, order-execution and live-trading controls on every certified route. Absence cannot be proven for routes outside the private-alpha journey.

The clean-clone network scan greps the private-alpha surface and the launcher for non-localhost host literals. It cannot prove the absence of a dynamically constructed URL; the browser certification's zero-forbidden-external-requests result is the runtime complement to it.
Owner review was NOT performed and cannot be performed by automation. Every checklist and report records it as OWNER_REVIEW_REQUIRED.
certification_limitations.consequence: No release may occur on the strength of this certification alone.

known_defects_found_and_fixed_in_this_mi.defect: prepare() could never return ok on a machine where installation had not already been performed in place, blocking init_first_run, apply_local_upgrade and the M165 gate.
known_defects_found_and_fixed_in_this_mi.found_by: M336 root-cause analysis of the inherited failures

known_defects_found_and_fixed_in_this_mi.defect: bin/saathi-local reported a missing venv when the real blocker was an unhealthy or unrelated listener, masking the PID-safety refusal.
The release gate counted a bare PEM header as a leaked private key and blocked on its own secret-rejection sample. Red since 79d3c29.
Every release manifest and certification report recorded the git SHA twice, because _git_sha(full=True) expanded to `git rev-parse HEAD HEAD`.
known_defects_found_and_fixed_in_this_mi.found_by: reading manifest output while writing the M338 contract

known_defects_found_and_fixed_in_this_mi.defect: Concurrent decide_approval calls could all succeed: the guard was a read-check-write, so one approval could record several decisions and a later approve could overwrite an earlier reject.
known_defects_found_and_fixed_in_this_mi.found_by: the M341 soak's approval-contention scenario; the sequential test passed and had always passed
known_defects_found_and_fixed_in_this_mi.status: FIXED — conditional UPDATE under the runtime lock

known_defects_found_and_fixed_in_this_mi.defect: The journey's cancellation probe reported success once a long-running tool finished, without ever issuing a cancel.
known_defects_found_and_fixed_in_this_mi.status: FIXED — a real runtime.cancel() is issued and the record reaches CANCELLED

known_defects_found_and_fixed_in_this_mi.defect: Two isolation probes were 'refused' by a TypeError from a malformed call signature, proving nothing about the boundary.
known_defects_found_and_fixed_in_this_mi.found_by: the M339 test asserting no refusal is a programming error
known_defects_found_and_fixed_in_this_mi.status: FIXED — rewritten against the real select_workspace API and a genuine second organization

known_defects_found_and_fixed_in_this_mi.defect: A browser-certification check was written as `... || true`, so it could never fail.
known_defects_found_and_fixed_in_this_mi.found_by: review of the first certification run

explicit_non_actions: No push, no merge, no pull request.
No public deployment and no DNS change.
No broker, exchange or provider connection.
No credential requested, accepted or stored.
No account, balance or position accessed.
No order submitted, modified or cancelled.
No paper or live execution enabled.
Owner review not performed or claimed.
The primary worktree and PRs #12 and #13 were not touched.
